frozenFrom.note: Ledger frozen before any verify_closure.py re-run. The 85 claiming commits predate the 2026-08-05 squash-merge of PR #722 and are unreachable from post-squash main; verify_closure.py derives claims from git log origin/main..HEAD, so a naive re-run reports claimedClosed=0 and would overwrite this map. Treat this file as the authoritative finding->commit claim record; closure truth is settled by reproduction, not by these claims.

claims.title: The board /rankings renders is not the board GET /api/data serves: the stock frontend body {"tep_multiplier":1.15} changes 627 of 740 ranks and 654 tiers while the response stamps isCustomized:false
/tools/source-health lists 4 of the 21 registered ranking sources and renders IDPTradeCalc as 0 rows because the count lookup is case-mismatched
/api/status source_health describes 2 of 21 sources: total_sources=2, source_counts covers ktc+idpTradeCalc only, and missing_sources is structurally always empty
A source that fails by returning zero rows or by a vendor header rename is dropped from the board with an EMPTY sourceParseErrors — the schema probe covers 4 of 22 sources
9 of 21 registered sources have no row-count floor — deleting ktcSfTep (the retail anchor, 501 rows) from the whole board leaves contractHealth 'healthy' with zero errors
Only 2 of 21 sources cast any vote on any draft pick, and all 72 slot picks are single-source: a fresh KTC pick value sits unread in canonicalSiteValues while the anchor is IDPTradeCalc alone
Two real players occupy two board rows each because name-variant drift splits one human across a resolved row and an unresolved ghost, stranding vendor votes
Both identity-duplicate detectors on the contract are structurally unable to fire, and scripts/audit_identity.py renders a permanently empty section for the one that would have caught W06-F001
/api/player/{sleeper_id}/realized returns unmapped_player for every player because the Sleeper block never contains the key the identity mapper is handed
config/identity/id_overrides.json cannot influence the board at all, and where it IS read the override loses to the directory it exists to override
unified_mapper.resolve_player merges 11 demonstrably different NFL players at its default threshold on today's real corpus, and the scraper's own fuzzy guard passes 5 of the same 11 pairs
resolve_many rebuilds the entire Sleeper directory index once per input row - 203x its own documented cost
dynastyNerdsSfTep.csv ships a stable SleeperId column that the ID-join alias list cannot see, so a 294-row source joins by name only
/api/scaffold/identity serves a 106-day-old identity report whose master players carry zero Sleeper IDs and whose pick table is empty, with no staleness marker on the response
One rostered player is absent from the board and from all three Sleeper identity maps while still appearing on his team's roster lists
Terminal re-derives each row's Sleeper ID by lowercased display name even though every row already carries playerId - verified correct on the live payload

Every /rankings page load silently POSTs tep_multiplier=1.15, which bypasses the ADR-015 TE-basis curve — the rendered board under-prices 82 TEs by up to 21.2% and disagrees with GET /api/data on 627 ranks, while every server-side engine keeps pricing from /api/data
/settings renders the forced TE-premium override as 'Default 1.15x' and its 'Reset to default' button writes the override, so no reachable UI state produces the non-override board

222 rows on the live board display a client-invented ordinal in the # column, and CLAUDE.md's stated bound for that fallback is factually wrong — the backend's board stops at rank 740, never reaching the 800 limit the doc cites
The board fabricates a tier, a positional rank, a confidence badge and an actionable BUY/SELL verdict for the 222 players it declines to price

The /trade calculator never sums the canonical board: the frontend posts an explicit tep_multiplier=1.15 on every load, which disables the ADR-015 TE basis conversion and reprices 129 of 809 players by up to -21.2%
The Value Adjustment tooltip tells the user the bonus goes to 'the side with fewer pieces', but 46.7% of fired VAs go to a side with equal or MORE pieces
Current-year (2026) draft picks cannot be found in the trade calculator's only search box — the exclusion is a hardcoded /^2026\b/ regex, not the contract's currentDraftYear
Trade suggestions returns zero suggestions for 8 of 12 live teams, with no diagnosis in the payload
Every trade the arbitrage finder returns is a 1-for-2; 1-for-1 candidates exist but rank 2,159th and 2-for-1 never qualifies at all
Draft picks can never appear in a trade-finder or trade-suggestion result: both engines resolve rosters from sleeper.teams[].players, which contains zero picks
No defensive back is eligible for any trade suggestion: the best DB on the board ranks 167th, past the top-150 gate, in a league that starts three of them
Monte Carlo uncertainty is a hard-coded flat +/-15% band on zero live rows, and the 9999 clamp makes it understate an elite asset by 5.07%
The leagueAdjusted valuation lens is a silent no-op on every all-offense trade in /api/trade/simulate and /api/trade/finder, while the response still stamps valuationMode: leagueAdjusted
The finder's 'high confidence' tier is structurally unreachable: it measures the scraper's 3-source site count against a 5-source baseline while the board blends up to 14
The finder's 'arbitrage' score is 80% own-side gain and 20% opponent appeal, so it ranks lopsidedness rather than the market/board gap it is named for
Finder metadata.myRosterSize reports the post-filter asset count, understating a 57-man roster as 34 and a 44-man roster as 12
The finder performs no dominance pruning: 40 returned trades for Jason are built from only 4 distinct give-side assets, one of which appears in 20 of them
Trade suggestions emits the same trade under two categories, so totalSuggestions overstates the distinct ideas produced
Monte Carlo run-to-run variance is small but no convergence statistic is exposed, and the panel that calls it 404s through the Next origin
mergeDraftCapitalTeams hard-caps every team's slot count at 6, so the user's team — which owns 31 of the 72 live picks — renders as "0/6 slots" with a 5.2x-wrong $/slot
Position FAAB calibration blends RAW dollar bids from three seasons with different budgets ($1000 / $200 / $100), inflating the RB anchor 5.0x and driving every bid too high
The rival-contention model reads the unscoped market contract while the user's own bid reads the valuation-lens-scoped one, and a single valuationMode is stamped for both
Clicking a /rankings row opens a popup whose BUY/SELL verdict contradicts the Edge column on the row you just clicked — 83 rows, including 7 of the top 15
The /rankings Edge column labels 32 of 35 top-250 tight ends SELL and every single SELL in the top 250 is a tight end — the 'retail vs expert' gap is measuring TE-premium basis, not mispricing

The 12-hour signal-alert cooldown is keyed on the rule TAG, so it never engages when the reason changes — which is exactly what changes when a signal flips — and the email then renders the flip as a first-ever signal
Direction is never gated on confidence: 253 of the 356 directional verbs on /rankings sit on rows the same page badges as low or no confidence, and 102 rest on a 'consensus' of two sources or fewer

Both live rule engines return HOLD 'Stable — no movement, volatility, or news triggers' for 665 of 665 rostered players because the rank-history log does not exist, and no surface says the evidence is missing
BDVM roster strategy capitals and the double-positive trade scan exclude every draft pick, omitting 8-52% of rebuilder capital and flipping 2 of 12 direction labels
Tier-form rookie picks in rounds 5-6 cannot be priced: the regex covers 1st-4th only, and the 24 affected rows are labelled with the factually wrong reason "unparseable_pick_name"

ROS playoff/championship sims run on the OLDEST loaded season (2024), not the newest — sorted(snapshot.seasons, key=luck._season_sort_key) passes objects to a function typed for strings, so every season sorts equal
The #1 ROS-strength team is told 'Seller — sell aging win-now players' on /league -> Trade Deadline because he is absent from the 2024 sim and absence is coerced to 0.0 playoff odds

direction.py's position-aware veteran-age table is unreachable in production — build_section never passes teams, so ageProfile is {} on all 12 live rows and the age-gated Strong Seller branch can never fire

Public trade letter grades silently drop 224 of 1,708 traded asset slots (13.1%) that the board cannot price — including 20 first-round-pick slots — and emit a confident 'Robbery'/'Fleeced' badge with no unpriced-asset disclosure anywhere on the payload or the page

Eight 2026 awards are manufactured from a season with zero scored games — 'Points King: Jason, 0.0 PF', 'Regular-Season Crown: Jason, 0-0', 'League MVP: Justin Jefferson, 0.0 VORP' — and the live Awards tab counts them into its 'N yrs' award-history badge
GET /api/gameplan and all 4,385 lines of src/roster_intel/ have zero frontend consumers — no page, no component, no Next bridge route references it

On the live /league Trade Deadline board the strongest roster in the league (Brent, ROS strength percentile 100%) is labelled 'Seller — sell aging win-now players' because an owner missing from the playoff sim is scored as 0% playoff odds
Terminal roster strength is the raw sum of rankDerivedValue over rostered players — no lineup solve, no starter/depth weighting, no positional deficit, and draft picks excluded entirely
PortfolioSummary renders a Total Value that excludes picks beside a 'Picks' legend that includes them — the three legend numbers sum to 314,562 under a Total Value of 171,495

frontend/lib/portfolio-insights.js prices every current-year draft pick at zero — 15,626 per team, 187,512 league-wide (39% of all pick capital) — because it is the one pick join in the tree that ignores contract.pickAliases
Four independent team-direction classifiers ship simultaneously and disagree on 9 of 12 teams; three are reachable by a user and none references the others
/rosters shows two contradictory rankings of the same 12 teams on one screen: Jason is #1 in the power table and #5 'Mid-Tier' in the tier cards 400px below
/phases classifies zero teams as 'Rebuild' on live data, so its headline trade-partner feature renders nothing and the page never says why
team-phase.js is a pure median split, so a 10x increase in one team's roster value changes nothing while a 50% cut to that team relabels a DIFFERENT team
/api/gameplan reports roster market / consensus / leagueAdjusted / pickValue as 0.0 for all 12 teams while the same payload reports marketPriceCoverage 627 of 666 priced

/api/gameplan flags 'only 2 of 3 dedicated DL slots filled' and urgentNeed=true on rosters whose own lineup solve in the same payload reports 21 of 21 slots filled — 6 position rows across 5 of 12 teams

The terminal labels all 665 rostered players 'Stable — no movement, volatility, or news triggers' while the same payload's delta panel correctly says 'Insufficient rank history'; data/rank_history.jsonl does not exist and source_value_history.jsonl holds one day
src/ros/direction.py's roster-strength percentile and roster age profile have no effect on any label, and only three of its seven labels occur on live data
The ops "scrape success rate < 50%" alert can never fire: the payload it is handed never carries the key, and /api/status carries it as a dict the float() cast rejects
A partial scrape that the promotion guard REFUSES to publish is recorded as a success — same event name, same history outcome, same last_success_at, and it increments scrape_count

The "fewer than half the sites returned" partial-scrape guard degenerates to "block only on total loss": `sites` carries 2 entries on the live snapshot and only lists sources that already produced values

verify-sharp-production.yml runs on EVERY push to main and always fails at `git add data/ops/...` because .gitignore excludes data/ — so its "Enforce healthy population" verdict step has never once executed
The Sharp production smoke reports `unmappedAssets` from `dataQuality`, a key /api/sharp/market has never emitted — it is hard-zero on every run

/api/metrics.data_age_seconds and /api/health.data_age_hours measure time since the process loaded the file, not since the data was scraped — they are numerically identical to uptime and reset to zero on every restart
/tools/source-health claims "Scraper status for every ranking source in the pipeline" and renders 4 sources; the live board blends 21
/api/status.source_health reports total_sources 2, sources_with_data 2, missing_sources [] for a board built from 21 sources — a 19-source outage would still read as 2 of 2 with nothing missing
CLAUDE.md attributes 239 client-numbered rows to the 800-rank limit; the board never reaches 800 and every one of those rows is unpriced

Trade suggestions cannot propose a defensive back to anyone — the top-150 board gate contains zero DBs — yet /trade tells all 12 teams to 'target DB' while every team already rosters 5-9 of them against a 3-DB requirement
The /angle page can never return an IDP player in a counter-package: the engine defaults include_idp=False and the page never sends the flag
/api/angle/find applies a +/-5% cross-market plausibility gate that is narrower than the two boards' own measured p10-p90 disagreement, and stamps no uncertainty band
The market-gap direction is computed in RANK space where no TE-basis correction exists, so 33 of 33 edge-eligible tight ends are SELL and none is BUY
CLAUDE.md's stated assetsUnpricedByBoard figure (202) does not match the live payload (186)

The live board is blind to the league's IDP scoring: defensive backs are the cheapest family (best DB at board rank 167) even though this league pays 5.32 per pass defensed and 5.32 per interception against 1.33 per solo tackle
/api/trade/suggestions emits two different value concepts under one field name, showing Travis Hunter at 5,637 on /trade while /rankings shows 4,401
valuationMode=leagueAdjusted is stamped on responses where 41% of asset legs are still priced on the unadjusted market board
trade-logic.js::displayValue ignores the user's per-player value override and its docstring describes a pick-year discount effectiveValue does not apply
Both playoff-odds engines publish 100%/0% certainty with zero games played and 14 weeks remaining, and the convergence check passes on it
Five incompatible percentile definitions; the one behind Power Rankings v1 returns a literal 0.0 for the league minimum and the one behind v2 returns 0.0 for an unmeasurable population
'Contender' is computed six different ways across six surfaces, from four unrelated input families
Team total value is computed three ways and the two simple sums differ by pick capital — 22.5% of a portfolio on the live snapshot
